Class LeadTriggerHandler

public without sharing class LeadTriggerHandler
extends TriggerHandler

Trigger handler for Lead object. Extends TriggerHandler framework to manage lead-related trigger events. Primary functionality includes mapping custom lead fields to converted Account, Contact, and Opportunity records during lead conversion that are not available through standard Salesforce configuration.

Methods

public override void afterUpdate()

Handles after update trigger events for Lead records. When a lead is converted, copies field values from the lead to the converted Account, Contact, and Opportunity based on mappings defined in FieldReplicationService.Settings.

private static List<SObject> buildMappedRecords(
  List<Lead> leads,
  Schema.SObjectType targetType,
  String settingName,
  String idField
)

Builds a list of target SObjects with field values copied from source leads.

Parameters:
    leads – Source Lead records to copy field values from.
    targetType – The SObjectType of records to create (Account, Contact, or Opportunity).
    settingName – The mapping setting name to lookup in mappingSettings.
    idField – The Lead field name containing the converted record Id.

Returns:
    List of SObjects with mapped field values, or empty list if no mapping exists.

private static SObject buildRecord(
  Schema.SObjectType targetType,
  Id recordId,
  List<FieldMap> fieldMaps,
  Lead source
)

Creates a single SObject with field values copied from a source lead.

Parameters:
    targetType – The SObjectType of the record to create.
    recordId – The Id to assign to the new record.
    fieldMaps – List of FieldMap defining source to target field mappings.
    source – The Lead record to copy field values from.

Returns:
    SObject with the specified Id and mapped field values.

private static List<Lead> getNewlyConvertedLeads()

Filters trigger records to return only leads that were just converted in this transaction.

Returns:
    List of Lead records where IsConverted changed from false to true.

private static void loadMappingSettings()

Lazily loads field mapping configurations from FieldReplicationService.Settings for Account, Contact, and Opportunity mappings. Only settings with mapped fields are added to the cache.
